newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.

text.p: Rubber futures closed narrowly mixed in moderate trade on late some speculative buying and selling interest, dealers said on Thursday.

"Prices were narrowly mixed in the morning and afternoon on some position adjustments. But activity was limited by lack of fresh incentives and because most people are reluctant to open or hold new positions ahead of the upcoming Lunar New Year and Hari Raya Puasa holidays," a local broker said.
"Activity was also dampened by lack of Chinese enquiries and quiet ring sessions," he said.
At around 0945 GMT, October/December RSS3 slipped half a cent to 127.25 U.S. cents a kg.
April RSS1 rose half a cent to 178.50 Singapore cents (US$1.27) a kg.
April TSR20 was unchanged from Wednesday's settlement of 171.00 Singapore cents (US$1.22) a kg.
